fal-ai/elevenlabs/tts/eleven-v3.description: The current ElevenLabs voice model, and still the one that sounds least like a machine reading.

pricing.note: fal publishes $0.1 per thousand characters, which is $0.0001 each and what the catalog stores.

fal-ai/elevenlabs/text-to-dialogue/eleve.description: Several speakers in one take, so the timing between lines is performed rather than edited. Nothing to type in the prompt box: the lines go in the list below, each with the voice that reads it.

fal-ai/elevenlabs/sound-effects/v2.description: A described noise, made to length. Cheap enough to try ten of.

pricing.note: fal publishes $0.002 per second of output.

fal-ai/elevenlabs/music.description: Full arrangements from a description, up to ten minutes.

pricing.note: fal publishes $0.6 per minute of output audio. Its length is `music_length_ms`, in milliseconds, which is why the entry names the field rather than letting the estimator guess at `duration`.
